blocks.title: Save. Disconnect. Go.
blocks.text: Save if possible. Let it finish. Press F2, choose Disconnect, then Proceed. Quit the game. Quitting may still crash; no fix is proven.
Unsaved progress may be lost. Tell the group later; no recap required.
F2 means F two. This party's exit rehearsal is not tested yet.

sections.title: Join, play, and leave well
sections.intro: Meet up. Adventure together. Leave when you need.

blocks.title: Before your first join
blocks.text: Match the group's collection. Finish Helgen or Helgen Express offline; save outside. Separate campaigns need separate characters.

items: Launch Skyrim Together; load your latest campaign save.
Press F2 or Right Ctrl. Choose Connect; use the host's private details.
Check Player Manager: join the party with the usual leader.
No party? The fixed leader creates it. Join before progressing quests.
Meet up, ready a heal, and say or type READY.

items.title: Arriving late
items.text: Join the party and regroup. Do not catch up by questing alone.

items.title: First room
items.text: Leader enters first. Ranger scouts; guardian intercepts; wizard attacks; healer keeps retreat space.

items.title: Need a minute?
items.text: Type HOLD or BRB. Find safety; menus and chat do not pause danger.

blocks.title: A normal goodbye
blocks.text: Find safety. Save and let it finish. F2, Disconnect, Proceed; quit. Each person saves locally; the server cannot replace your save.
Save before major scenes. If progress disagrees, stop and tell the host. Never reload while connected or repair quests alone.

sections.title: Make room for specialists
sections.intro: Choose a useful specialty; friends cover your gaps. These are flexible build ideas.

items.title: Healer or paladin
items.text: Restoration first; add personal defense. A paladin swaps between shield, weapon and healing.
items: Give: recovery.
Ask: protect my casts.
Ordinary robes or steel work; legendary gear can wait.

items.title: Two-handed guardian
items.text: Greatsword, Heavy Armor and Block make space. Turn to protect a chased friend.
items: Give: breathing room.
Ask: answer distant casters.
No guaranteed taunt; weapon blocking lacks shield-only defenses.

items.title: Stealth ranger
items.text: Archery and Sneak find the opening. Keep moving and shooting after discovery.
items: Give: scouting and focused damage.
Ask: a quiet opening, then cover.
Start with leather and a bow; sneak bonuses are not guaranteed.

items.title: Gandalf-style wizard
items.text: Destruction and Alteration supply fire and protection; add backup Restoration. Earn a staff later.
items: Give: ranged magic and guidance.
Ask: casting space; warn me before scouting.
Robes suffice. Extra costume mods need collection approval.

items.title: Gravewarden
items.text: Restoration first, Conjuration second. One conjured helper buys healing time; raising corpses is different.
items: Give: recovery and distraction.
Ask: room for the helper.
Corpse raising stays held, even in a darker story.

items.title: Storyteller or controller
items.text: Speech, Restoration and a weapon suit a skald; enemy control needs a reliable damage fallback.
items: Give: support and shared decisions.
Ask: respect control calls.
No promised instruments or buff songs. The quest face remains the fixed leader.

blocks.title: Keep the role fun
blocks.text: Keep a fallback. Revisit your specialty after two sessions; discuss major changes so someone still covers healing.
Healing experience, ally perk bonuses, added summons and full combinations are not tested yet. Check installed tooltips and the rules before spending points.

sections.title: Make room for everyone
sections.intro: Protect casting space. Finish threats. Give everyone a turn.

blocks.title: One leader per playthrough
blocks.text: Keep one leader for the entire campaign: quest NPCs, scenes, items and entering locations first. Everyone can fight bosses and solve puzzles.
Share story choices without rotating leadership. A different leader needs a separate campaign and characters.

items.title: On me
items.text: A pursuer? Move toward the group; the frontliner intercepts. No permanent aggro promise.

items.title: Healing here
items.text: Come within reach. Healing is not resurrection; wards do not guarantee group protection.

items.title: Caster first
items.text: Focus the named threat. Keep a retreat route open.

blocks.title: Typing counts
blocks.text: F2 or Right Ctrl; click chat, type, then Enter. Ordinary messages are global. Try /party READY or /local Hello. Four-player delivery and readability are not tested yet.

items: READY: ready to proceed.
HOLD: find safety and wait.
HELP: help now; give location.
BRB: taking a break.
Wait for typing. Watch and acknowledge chat. Automatic text-to-speech is not promised.

blocks.text: Use matching mods. Menus stay live. Target lock selects hostiles; aim heals manually. Player friendly fire is off; neutral characters remain vulnerable. Review additions together.

sections.title: Gear, gold and homes
sections.intro: Your save, pack and gold are personal.

items.title: Gear and loot
items.text: Offer upgrades before selling. Leader takes quest items. Stop if anything vanishes or duplicates.

items.title: Gold
items.text: No automatic party purse. Zero percentage death penalty still leaves crime fines.

items.title: Check home storage
items.text: Recognized home containers are intended to stay local. Test the exact chest with a cheap item, save and rejoin. No blanket privacy or permanence guarantee; your friend's chest is not your delivery box.

items.title: Meeting place, not bank
items.text: Shared containers are not permanent banks. Guild, outdoor and modded storage needs checks. Empty rooms before renovations remove containers.

blocks.title: Hand-off: not tested yet
blocks.text: Try one cheap item in an unowned container outside a home. Full menu: donor deposits and closes; recipient takes. Both check packs, save and rejoin. Never trade floor drops.
One person at a time. Stop on disagreement. Gold, crafted items and QuickLoot transfers remain not tested yet.

items.title: Buy a city home
items.text: Fixed leader completes prerequisites; buy from the steward. Budget separately for furnishings. Do not repeat quests alone.

items.title: Build with Hearthfire
items.text: Plots cost 5,000 gold before construction. Use the drafting table and carpenter's bench. Shared building is not tested yet.

items.title: Check each character
items.text: Nonleader payments, keys, access and furnishings are not tested yet. Promise neither one shared purchase nor four required payments.

blocks.title: Proposed ownership compact
blocks.text: Proposed etiquette, not accepted. If adopted: our agreement, not the game's rules.
items: Your gear and gold; no spawning, duplication or reload-farming.
Offer upgrades; alternate ties. No leader bonus.
Leader handles quest NPCs and items.
Shared costs voluntary; pledges aren't payments.
Name supply holders; test personal storage.
Earn homes; agree buyer and guest use.
Protect absent players' belongings and story.

blocks.text: Optional: name the company, share crafting interests, choose a home goal. Record supplies as pledged, held or spent.
Family systems, horse ownership after reconnecting and custom-item supply chains are not tested yet.
